guarantees: Plank sales begin as a two-way NPC conversation with explicit offer and acceptance or refusal.
After acceptance the seller carries the reserved plank, walks to the buyer, hands it over, and only then receives two coins.
Residents keep one plank for their own future construction and sell only surplus to a buyer who owns none, preventing immediate resale churn.
Malformed task GUIDs, unsupported food prices, unsupported wage amounts, and invalid accounts leave balances and ledgers unchanged.
Schema-3 unfinished work with no treasury funds migrates to unfunded, later reserves funds without paying early, and settles exactly once after completion.
Conversation, trade, wallet, inventory, wage, and transaction state validates and survives reload.
